method: Unique cases identified by filename and title; latest attempt selected using its actual start timestamp. All earlier outcomes retained.
limits: This aggregate records local E2E results and does not by itself attest an authenticated production deployment or native Android/iOS packaging.
Screenshots use synthetic local data; no production account, token, email delivery, or raw error payload is included.

The first full run had 19 failures. Targeted re-executions followed corrections to legacy expectations, the standalone footer, a route alias, and server stabilization. Intermediate failures remain visible in the attempt history.
